12. 某遊樂場的實際面積為 900 m²。若該遊樂場在某地圖上的面積為 36 cm²，則該地圖的比例尺為
A. 1 : 25
B. 1 : 50
C. 1 : 500
D. 1 : 250 000
reasoning: Convert real area to cm²: 900 m² = 900 × 10 000 cm² = 9 000 000 cm². Map area is 36 cm². The linear scale factor squared = real area / map area = 9 000 000 / 36 = 250 000. Taking the square root gives the linear scale factor = sqrt(250 000) = 500. Hence the map scale is 1 : 500, which corresponds to option C.
